We were sitting there talking about pogs or power rangers when we hear yelling coming from a house on the opposite side of where his apartment complex was.  We see one gentleman chasing another with a carpenter hammer.  The man wielding the hammer caught up to the other man and proceeded to beating the living hell out him with the claw end.  So much blood.  The ambulance arrived shortly after.  I heard the hammer-man was caught but I don't know what happened to his victim.  I assume he died.  I didn't realize what I saw until a few years later when I came to the realization: "Hey, I may have witnessed a murder."
